# AgentsFlow — Complete Documentation

> Universal AI agent manager for multi-platform development environments. Discover, orchestrate, monitor, and manage all your AI coding agents from a single control plane.

## What is AgentsFlow?

AgentsFlow is a unified platform to discover, orchestrate, monitor, and manage AI coding agents across every tool and environment you use — from a single control plane. It sits above individual agents (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Copilot, Antigravity, Windsurf) and provides the management layer that no single vendor will build.

## What problem does AgentsFlow solve?

The AI agent landscape in 2026 is fragmented by design. Each vendor builds their agent as a silo. Developers use 3-5 agents simultaneously with no unified view, no cross-agent orchestration, no shared context, no performance monitoring, and manual agent selection for every task.

AgentsFlow provides:
- Agent Discovery — Automatically detect all installed AI agents, versions, and configurations
- Unified Registry — One place to see every agent, capabilities, health, and status
- Task Routing — Route tasks to the best agent based on type, complexity, and strengths
- Context Sharing — Share relevant context between agents without duplicating tokens
- Health Monitoring — Track availability, response times, and error rates
- Config Management — Manage configurations from one place, sync across environments

## Supported agents

| Agent | Vendor | Config Directory |
|-------|--------|------------------|
| Claude Code | Anthropic | ~/.claude/ |
| Cowork | Anthropic | Via plugins |
| Codex CLI | OpenAI | ~/.codex/ |
| Google Antigravity | Google | ~/.gemini/ |
| Cursor | Anysphere | ~/.cursor/ |
| Windsurf | Codeium | ~/.codeium/ |
| GitHub Copilot | Microsoft | .github/ |
| Warp AI | Warp | ~/.warp/ |
| Amp | Sourcegraph | ~/.amp/ |
| OpenHands | All Hands AI | .openhands/ |
| Goose | Block | ~/.goose/ |

## Architecture

AgentsFlow follows a 4-layer architecture:

1. @agentsflow/core — Engine: discovery, registry, health checks, task routing, context bridge
2. @agentsflow/cli — Interactive CLI (Commander.js) — primary interface, CLI-first (~200 tokens/command)
3. @agentsflow/mcp — MCP server for agents that support MCP — progressive disclosure, minimal schemas
4. @agentsflow/sdk — SDK for developers to build custom agent integrations

Apps layer:
- apps/dashboard — Vite + React (local management dashboard)
- apps/web — Next.js (AgentsFlow Cloud, future)

### Design principles

1. CLI-first, MCP-optional — CLI costs ~200 tokens vs 44,000+ for MCP schemas
2. Agent-agnostic — Treats every agent as first-class citizen
3. Progressive disclosure — Only essential metadata at startup
4. Complementary — Doesn't replace agents, makes them work together

## CLI Commands

```bash
agentsflow scan              # Discover all installed AI agents
agentsflow status            # Health and availability per agent
agentsflow agents            # List agents with capabilities
agentsflow agents --detail   # Detailed agent info
agentsflow config            # View/edit agent configurations
agentsflow route "task"      # Route task to best agent
agentsflow context share     # Share context between agents
agentsflow dashboard         # Launch React management UI
agentsflow --help            # Full command reference
```

## MCP Server

Add to claude_desktop_config.json:
```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "agentsflow": {
      "command": "npx",
      "args": ["-y", "@agentsflow/mcp"]
    }
  }
}
```

MCP Tools:
- agentsflow_scan — Discover installed agents
- agentsflow_status — Check agent health
- agentsflow_route — Route task to best agent
- agentsflow_context — Share context between agents
- agentsflow_config — Read/write agent configurations

## Packages

| Package | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| @agentsflow/core | Engine — discovery, registry, health, routing |
| @agentsflow/cli | Interactive terminal interface |
| @agentsflow/mcp | MCP server for cross-agent orchestration |
| @agentsflow/sdk | SDK for building agent integrations |
| @agentsflow/agents | Agent registry and definitions |
| @agentsflow/registry | Public agent catalog |

## Relation to SkillFlow

AgentsFlow and SkillFlow are sister projects in the Fluity ecosystem:
- SkillFlow (https://github.com/MAUGUS2/skillflow) manages skills — what agents know how to do
- AgentsFlow manages agents — the AI systems themselves

Together they provide complete visibility and control over multi-agent development environments.

## Tech Stack

TypeScript (strict), pnpm workspaces, tsup (build), Zod (validation), Commander.js (CLI), MCP SDK, React 18, Vite, Tailwind CSS, Vitest.
